name: IME / Independent Medical Education Providers

pain_points: Reporting burden for accreditation and sponsors

fit_logic.proceed: Recurring programmes + sponsor reporting pressure + ability to act on insight
fit_logic.park: Wants outcomes but has no operational owner for iteration
fit_logic.stop: Expects Yoke to solve audience acquisition without a channel

what_they_sell: Education programmes with evidence of impact
what_proof_means: Outcomes evidence aligned to accreditation expectations. Sponsor reporting that supports renewal and larger packages.
yoke_weaknesses: If they expect Yoke to solve audience acquisition without a channel

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke helps IME providers streamline sponsor reporting and prove programme impact—with accreditation-ready outcomes and longitudinal insight.
key_benefits: Maintain accreditation compliance with audit trails
Iterate mid-programme based on real-time insight
messaging.elevator_pitch: IME providers face heavy reporting burdens and sponsor pressure for proof. Yoke automates outcomes evidence and provides trendlines—defending renewals and supporting larger packages.

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase sponsor renewals with outcomes evidence
two_lever_framing.lever_b: Reduce reporting burden and programme fragmentation
